scripts.build: npm run generate --workspace @myerp/server && npm run build --workspace @myerp/server && npm run build --workspace @myerp/client
scripts.build:server: npm run generate --workspace @myerp/server && npm run build --workspace @myerp/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @myerp/server && npm run lint --workspace @myerp/client
scripts.start: npm run start --workspace @myerp/server & npm run preview --workspace @myerp/client
scripts.docker:migrate: docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec api npm run migrate
scripts.docker:seed: docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec api npm run seed
